The shared cache is on by default. An admin can change it in the **Shared cache**
tab of your Kiln settings. This page shows the settings and who can change them.

## Where the settings apply

The tab shows one row for the **Organization default** and one row for each
repository override. To change a row, click **Edit**.

| Level                | What it controls                   |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Organization default | The settings for every repository. |
| Repository override  | The settings for one repository.   |

A repository override can set each setting, or keep **Default** to use the
organization's value. If the organization did not change a setting, the job uses
the Kiln default.

## The settings

| Setting             | Values                                | Kiln default                                       |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| **Shared cache**    | On, Off                               | On                                                 |
| **Cache**, per tool | On, Off                               | `actions/cache` and Bazel on. sccache and Nix off. |
| **Uses cache from** | This branch and default, All branches | This branch and default                            |

**Shared cache** is the main switch. When it is off, no tool uses the shared cache.
Kiln keeps the tool settings, and uses them again when you turn the cache back on.

**Cache** turns one tool on or off. See
[What the cache supports](/kiln/cache/index#what-the-cache-supports). When a tool is
off, Kiln does not set up that tool for the job.

## Which branches a job uses cache from

**Uses cache from** is available for Bazel, sccache, and Nix. `actions/cache` always
follows the GitHub rules.

| Value                       | A job uses cache entries from                                                   |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **This branch and default** | Its own branch and the default branch.                                          |
| **All branches**            | Its own branch and the default branch, then any other branch in the repository. |

With either value, a job writes only to its own branch. For Bazel, the setting
applies to the action cache.

With **All branches**, a job first looks in its own branch and in the default
branch. It uses an entry from another branch only when those do not have one.

<Warning>
  With All branches, a person who can push a branch can change what the default
  branch builds. Keep **This branch and default** for a repository that releases
  from its default branch. For Nix, keep it if you deploy from Nix builds.
</Warning>

A fork pull request never uses entries from other branches. In a repository where
a tool uses **All branches**, a job that Kiln cannot confirm comes from the same
repository gets read-only cache access.

## Who can change the settings

| Row                  | Who can change it                                                                    |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Organization default | An organization admin.                                                               |
| Repository override  | An organization admin, or a person with the admin role on that repository on GitHub. |

## When a change applies

Kiln reads the settings when a job starts. A job that already started keeps its
settings until it ends.

## Use the GitHub cache for one job

To keep the shared cache on but use the GitHub cache for `actions/cache` in one job,
add `cache=github` to the job's `runs-on` label. This changes only
`actions/cache`. See [The cache option](/kiln/cache/index#the-cache-option).
